subject: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal

Team —

Quick summary: Cedarstone (Tom Reynolds) has made prioritization of an "on-demand model snapshot" capability a gating item for a signed committed contract. They want the ability to take immutable, point-in-time snapshots of a served model version (including weights/hash metadata and prompt schema) and request that we be able to restore traffic or produce exact inference repros against that snapshot for audits. Their use-case is driven by regulatory audits and internal change-control: they want an auditable path to reproduce responses for specific customer batches.

Why this matters:
- ARR at stake: ~$1.8M committed ARR over 24 months if we can close by EOY.
- Timeline: Cedarstone expects a runnable plan in 2 weeks; contract signature targeted mid-November.
- Compliance ask: snapshots must be immutable, exportable, and include metadata for model and routing configuration (they specifically called out ability to tie a snapshot to a HubSpot record and to our trace IDs).

Asks from product/eng:
1) Is on-demand immutable snapshotting feasible without rearchitecting serving? Quick call for triage (30m) so we can put a conservative estimate in the MAP.
2) If full functionality is expensive, what's the smallest MVP we can deliver that satisfies audit replay for a single customer (Cedarstone) and aligns with our long-term model management roadmaps?
3) Security/legal inputs on retention/export formats (looping Laura).

Attached: draft MAP and Cedarstone evidence request from their compliance team.

Next steps I propose: 30m triage today or tomorrow; sales will commit a pilot budget if we can land a scoped delivery window.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20260929_Cedarstone_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP), cedarstone_soc2_evidence_request.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal

Thanks for the clear summary, Jasmine. A few clarifying Qs before we spin up a triage: 

1) When Cedarstone says "snapshot", do they expect a full runtime checkpoint (weights + KV cache + optimizer state) for deterministic replay, or are they satisfied with a model artifact + config + input logs that allow deterministic inference given a compatible runtime?
2) What SLO for replay latency and retention window are they expecting? (e.g., keep snapshots for 1 year, replay within 24h)
3) Any constraints on export format for legal/compliance? They mentioned tying snapshots to records — are they asking for an attachment in the tenant's control plane or a downloadable bundle?

Mina/ENG: can you weigh in with a ballpark level-of-effort and whether a staged approach (exportable artifact + documented replay steps) would meet the audit ask for an MVP?

I'll block 30 mins in the calendar for triage pending answers — prefer today 3pm PT or tomorrow 10am PT.

- Karthik
Product Lead, Model Management

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal

Quick engineering read:

- Full runtime checkpointing (weights + exact KV cache + ephemeral execution state) is heavy: it requires storage surface area per-snapshot and deterministic runtime guarantees we don't currently promise. That said, for audit replay we don't necessarily need optimizer state — inference is deterministic if we control model artifact, tokenizer, seed, and runtime kernel versions.

- Proposed MVP (3-phase):
  Phase 0 (spike, 1 week): prototype an export bundle that contains model artifact hash, tokenizer version, exact model config, routing config, and a small "replay manifest" with input records and trace IDs. Verify that replay on a staged runtime reproduces outputs.
  Phase 1 (deliverable, 3-4 weeks): add an API to trigger an export bundle for a tenant, store bundles in a secured bucket with immutability flags, and a simple internal tool to replay a bundle on QA nodes.
  Phase 2 (hardening, 4-6 weeks): scaleability, retention UI, and optional integration with customer-managed storage (for classified customers).

- Ballpark: 6-11 engineer-weeks across runtime, model-management, and infra for Phase 0+1. Phase 2 TBD after Phase 1 acceptance.

Risk/notes:
- Storage costs will be non-trivial if customers request long retention windows for large models.
- We need legal on export format to ensure it meets audit evidentiary requirements (Laura).

If we can scope Cedarstone to Phase 0+1 as an initial acceptance condition, we can make a conservative delivery estimate and include it in the MAP.

— Mina
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal

Looping in sales perspective: Cedarstone is firm on this being a gating item. Tom's note: "we need proof we can reproduce responses for any customer-submitted audit window — otherwise our counsel won't sign."

Negotiation leverage: Cedarstone is willing to commit to a 24-month contract with a 2x price uplift on dedicated capacity if we can guarantee scoped Phase 0+1 delivery with an explicit acceptance test. They also offered to fund a small implementation engineering retainer (covers 20% of the estimated eng cost) if necessary.

Ask to Product/Eng: can we sign up to Phase 0+1 delivery timeframe (spike + 3-4 weeks) in the MAP as a conditional milestone? If so, sales will move to finalize terms this week.

Attachments: MAP (final attached), Cedarsone compliance workbook (from Tom).

— Ben
Enterprise AE

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cedarstone.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@cedarstone.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-demand model snapshotting — prioritization request for Cedarstone deal

Thanks all for the quick reads and the concrete proposal, Mina. To summarize agreed next steps for the MAP and for Sales: 

1) Product/Eng sign-off on a scoped Phase 0+1 delivery window (spike + 3-4 weeks) so Sales can commit to Cedarstone timeline in the MAP.
2) Engineering to produce a short RFC (1-2 pages) listing the Phase 0 acceptance criteria and estimated cost/risks — Karthik/Mina to own. Target: EOD Friday.
3) Laura to confirm legal/export format constraints; Laura, can you flag any absolute no-go formats or retention liabilities?
4) Sales will update the MAP to include the conditional milestone and the pilot retainer offer; Ben to coordinate legal review with Cedarstone counsel.

If we can hit these commitments, Ben confirms Cedarstone moves forward with signature path immediately after. Jasmine will coordinate a 30m triage with Product/Eng tomorrow at 10am PT (calendar invite sent).
